en: The factory data of AP board is abnormal; please replace the AP board with a new one.
pt: dados de fábrica da placa AP com defeito

en: The AMS module is malfunctioning. Please restart the device.
pt: AMS com defeito; reinicie a impressora

en: The nozzle is covered with filament, or the build plate is crooked.
pt: bico coberto de filamento ou placa torta

en: Failed to resume previous print.
pt: não conseguiu retomar a impressão anterior

en: The bed temperature exceeds the filament's vitrification temperature, which may cause a nozzle clog. Please keep the front door of the printer open or lower the bed temperature.
pt: mesa quente para este filamento; abra a porta

en: The heatbed temperature is abnormal; the heater may have an open circuit, or the thermal switch may be open.
pt: aquecedor da mesa aberto ou chave térmica aberta

en: Micro Lidar lens seems to be dirty. Please clean the lens.
pt: lente do Micro Lidar suja; limpe

en: Failed to get image from Live View Camera. Spaghetti and waste chute pileup detection is not available at this time.
pt: câmera sem imagem; sem detecção de espaguete

en: The hotend cooling fan speed is slow. It may be stuck and need cleaning.
pt: ventoinha do bico lenta; limpe

en: The content of task file is unreadable; please resend the task.
pt: arquivo ilegível; mande a impressão de novo

en: The extruder servo motor has a short-circuit. It may have failed.
pt: motor da extrusora em curto; pode ter queimado
